findings.quoted_text: EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE      LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED      FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.
EXCEPT FOR CLAIMS UNDER SECTION 9 HEREOF, THE LIABILITY OF A PARTY TO THE OTHER FOR DIRECT DAMAGES SHALL NOT EXCEED FIFTEEN MILLION DOLLARS.
findings.explanation: Claims under Section 9 for indemnification and intellectual property infringement are excluded from the liability cap and have no separate limit, exposing you to uncapped liability for those claims.
findings.suggested_change: The liability of a party to the other for direct damages, including any claims under Section 9 hereof, shall not exceed fifteen million dollars.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello. I am reviewing the agreement and would like to propose a minor adjustment. - Regarding the relevant clause, claims under Section 9 are currently excluded from the liability cap, which creates potential uncapped liability. I propose modifying the agreement so that the liability for direct damages, including any claims under Section 9, does not exceed fifteen million dollars. Best regards,
